id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

baseModel.description: Base {@link ReliabilityMlModel} that is used for the #experimentalModel.

workflowRun.description: The workflow run that is used to trigger the experiment.

hyperparameterOverrides.description: The hyperparameter overrides added to the original model used when triggering the experiment.

experimentalModel.description:
**Do not update this field manually*

The experimental model, this is populated by #workflowRun is completed.

alertData.description:
JSON output from the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#process} and {@link ReliabilityMlModel#interpret} steps over #experimentalModel.

This JSON stores the timestamps when alerts were generated and contains columns for each model feature
used to generate them (feature contributions).

```
| timestamp           | feature1 | feature2 | featureN |
|---------------------|----------|----------|----------|
| 2024-01-01 00:00:00 | 0.5      | 0.2      | 0.3      |  // All values are normalized
| 2024-01-16 00:00:00 | 0.6      | 0.2      | 0.2      |
```

The process to generate this JSON is as follows:
- Run {@link ReliabilityMlModel#process} on the replicated model and extract the primary model output for alerts
  ({@link ReliabilityMl.Project#alertOutputs}).
- Run {@link ReliabilityMlModel#interpret} on the replicated model and extract the feature contribution data
  (`featureInterpretations`).

baseModelAlertData.description:
JSON output from the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#process} and {@link ReliabilityMlModel#interpret} steps over #baseModel.
This JSON is stored the same way as #alertData, but it contains the alerts generated by the base model.

algorithmData.description:
{@link Data} output from the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#process} over the #experimentalModel

This DataFrame contains a column per {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#algorithmOutputs}, stored as a timeseries.

```
| timestamp           | riskScore | riskScoreNormalized |
|---------------------|-----------|---------------------|
| 2024-01-01 00:00:00 | 100       | 0.66                |
| 2024-01-02 00:00:00 | 150       | 1.0                 |
| 2024-01-03 00:00:00 | 120       | 0.80                |
| 2024-01-04 00:00:00 | 130       | 0.86                |
```

baseModelAlgorithmData.description:
{@link Data} output from the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#process} over the #baseModel, and is stored the same as
#algorithmData.

featureOutputData.description:
A map of {@link Feature#id}s to the {@link Data} output from the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#process} and indexed
through {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#featureOutputs}.

**NOTE**: {@link Map} is defined as `<string, any>` instead of `<string, Data>` because the metadata system is
          not persisting the map correctly, so we can use `any` to store it as a `Boxed<json>` instead.

title:
Entity type to represent an experiment. The purpose of the experiment is to get a
glimpse of the primary model output and generated alerts after
inference related hyperparameters have been changed.
name: ReliabilityMlModelExperiment
